terra.problem: The line says God judged Topheth “as a symbol of evil,” but the passages describe it as a defiled place and foretell that it will become a burial ground. They also compare Jerusalem to it. State those details instead.
“After that, no one could sacrifice” presents the result as certain. 2 Kings 23:10 gives Josiah’s purpose: he desecrated Topheth so that no one could sacrifice children there.
“Desecrated” and “prophesy” may be difficult at a 5th-grade reading level. Consider “made unclean” and “deliver God’s message.”
